title: Flex - Energy Overload
description:
Flex Energy Overload was created to support the launch of Flex's new VIP branch in Kuwait and drive awareness, sales inquiries, and footfall to the location.

Astroshot produced a five-reel campaign designed for both organic social media and paid advertising. The content system combined multiple formats: explanatory ad content to communicate the benefits of the new packages, trend-based reels to keep the campaign relevant on social platforms, and cinematic content to showcase the gym experience, facilities, pool, training areas, and premium details of the new branch.

Instead of treating the launch as one video, Astroshot built a compact social campaign that helped audiences understand what the new VIP branch offers and what it feels like to become a customer there. Each reel had a clear role in the campaign, from explaining the offer to creating desire around the space and lifestyle.

title: Gulf Bank - Marathon 2025
description:
For the 2025 Gulf Bank Marathon, Astroshot supported one of Gulf Bank's biggest public events with real-time social media content, event coverage, and platform management across Instagram and X.

The scope covered the full campaign environment: press conference coverage before the marathon, on-ground event coverage during the race, social media content creation, and live updates that kept audiences informed and engaged throughout the event.

Astroshot's role was not limited to capturing highlights. The team helped Gulf Bank communicate the energy, scale, and momentum of the marathon across digital channels, turning the event into an active social media story before, during, and after race day.

title: Jahez - In the Sky
description:
Jahez takes to the skies with a massive balloon carrying the message of 180 days of free delivery.
This bold and eye-catching activation captures attention from afar, turning heads and sparking curiosity for the Jahez app.
A perfect blend of creativity and visibility, making a free delivery offer feel larger than life.
